audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Gnar, Gnar — four rows away from the published mirror.
audit.why: The mirror audit (gnar__warwick) set the chart to Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Warwick as one atomic group across both its layers. Rows 0, 2, 5 and 6 disagreed.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the mirror on both layers as one atomic group, ratings rescaled (4/10 on Gnar rows, 5/10 on Skill rows, 6/10 at 2+ items). whys[0..6] rewritten to agree. diffRating dropped from 8.5/10 to 6/10 and tone off the HARD red, since 8.5/10 contradicted a diff of EVEN and a 54.04% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described Mega Gnar as an unbeatable late scaler and gave no cooldowns.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30s, so late it is up for almost every fight — but Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on maximum health, which is exactly what Mega Gnar stacks. Hop is 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s, and it is his only escape in mini form.
audit.corrected: spikes[3], late, phases[6].why and whys[6] now key the item stages to the max-health scaling and the 30s ult timer instead of a flat 'he out-scales you'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you Infinite Duress simply suppresses Gnar and wins the fight, and claimed Primal Howl's fear 'cancels his hop escape'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is flagged channel: interruptible. Mega Wallop's stun and GNAR! both cancel it outright, which makes his Rage bar — not his health bar — the thing you read before ulting. The mirror agent made this same reversal the centrepiece of its rewrite. Whether a fear stops Hop mid-flight is not in Riot's text, so that claim was removed rather than restated.
audit.corrected: The channel-cancel is now in whys[4], phases[4].why, spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and wants.foe[1]. The unverifiable Hop-fear claim was cut from mid.

edits.before: Warwick's passive sustain and charged Q dominate a CC-less mini-Gnar at level 1.
edits.after: Level 1 is Gnar's — Boomerang Throw pokes from 1100 range and your Q reaches 365.

edits.before: Level 2 is a skill window as Gnar's boomerang poke starts to answer your trades.
edits.after: Level 2 stays Gnar's — Hyper is a 7s speed buff he uses to walk back out of reach.

edits.before: At 3 your Blood Hunt speed and reset trades out-sustain Gnar's mini-form poke.
edits.after: Level 3 is skill — you out-sustain his poke only if you catch him off the hop.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you can chase down and punish any low Gnar before he reaches Rage.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are skill — Hop is 17s at rank 3, so fight in the window it is down.

edits.before: Your level 6 Infinite Duress suppresses Gnar and drags him under tower for the kill.
edits.after: Level 6 is skill — Duress is a channel, and Mega Wallop or GNAR! cancels it outright.

edits.before: At first item Mega Gnar's Rage-form stats and R wall-stun let him bully back.
edits.after: First item is skill — his Bramble Vest blunts the healing that carries your trades.

edits.before: With items Mega Gnar's flip and tankiness out-scale your single-target engage.
edits.after: With 2+ items you win — Jaws of the Beast scales off the health Mega Gnar stacks.

edits.before: Infinite Duress suppresses Gnar out of any Rage momentum and drags him under your tower; if he's near-Rage bait the transform then all-in the moment mini-Gnar returns, since your R plus Primal Howl fear ruins his escape.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a channel and Mega Wallop or GNAR! cancels it, so read his Rage bar rather than his health bar. Ult mini-Gnar, or wait out the Mega window and all-in the frame he reverts, holding Primal Howl for his stun.

edits.before: Mega Gnar becomes a frontline monster who can flip you into his team with R; without flash you can't reliably land Infinite Duress through his crowd control, so peel and pick isolated targets instead.
edits.after: Mega Gnar flips you into his team with GNAR! on a 30s cooldown at rank 3, and it cancels your ult — but Jaws of the Beast scales off the health he stacks, so bite the tank and spend Duress on somebody else.

edits.before: From 3 through 6 you own the lane; Blood Hunt reveals and speeds you onto any low Gnar, Primal Howl's fear cancels his hop escape, and Infinite Duress under tower converts a bad Gnar position into a kill before he can Rage.
edits.after: From 3 through 6 it stays close; Blood Hunt only speeds you onto a Gnar already under 50% health, and Hop is 22s at rank 1, so the window it is down is the window you fight in. Do not ult into full Rage — Mega Wallop's stun cancels the channel.

edits.before: Once Mega Gnar comes online at items the matchup flips: his GNAR! (R) wall-stun and beefy stats let him win extended fights and disengage your all-ins, so trade the lane for jungle pressure and pick him only in mini-form.
edits.after: Once he stacks health, Jaws of the Beast scales with it, so extended fights start suiting you — the danger is timing, not stats. GNAR! is 30s at rank 3 and cancels Infinite Duress, so open with Primal Howl, eat the stun, then ult.

edits.before: Land Mega GNAR! (R) wall-stun to peel your R
edits.after: Cancel Infinite Duress with Mega Wallop or GNAR!

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gnar's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s but it is a channel: Mega Wallop's stun and GNAR! both cancel it. Ult mini-Gnar, or ult once his Mega window closes.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gnar carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, Jaws of the Beast scales off the health Mega Gnar stacks — your side-lane pattern beats his once that ultimate is spent.

edits.after: - GNAR!: 90/60/30s and it cancels your ult — read his Rage bar, not just the timer. - Hop: 22s at rank 1, his only escape in mini form. - Infinite Duress: 110s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.after: Q-bite Gnar as he steps up, hold Q to follow his Hop, and let Eternal Hunger heal you back once you drop under half.
